cornerstone.full_quote: Each Cornerstone Investor has agreed that it will not, whether directly or indirectly, at any time during the period of twelve months from (and inclusive of) the Listing Date (the “Lock-up Period”), dispose of, in any way, any of the Offer Shares or any interest in any company or entity holding such Offer Shares that they have purchased pursuant to the relevant Cornerstone Investment Agreement
cornerstone.basis: TWELVE calendar months from (and inclusive of) the Listing Date; frees up on the 12-month anniversary of the Listing Date
cornerstone.notes: Deviation: cornerstone lock-up is 12 months, not 6.

controller_6m.full_quote: (a) in the period commencing on the date by reference to which disclosure of its, his or her shareholding in our Company is made in this prospectus and ending on the expiration date of the six months from the Listing Date (the “First Six-Month Period”), either directly or indirectly, dispose of, enter into any agreement to dispose of or otherwise create any options, rights, interests or encumbrances in respect of any of those Shares or securities of our Company in respect of which he, she or it is shown by this prospectus to be the beneficial owner
controller_6m.basis: Rule 10.07(1) undertaking: First Six-Month Period ends on the expiration date of the six months from the Listing Date; inclusive endpoint, first free day is the day after the six-month anniversary

controller_12m.full_quote: (b) at any time during the period of the following six months commencing on the date on which the First Six-Month Period expires (the “Second Six-Month Period”, together with the First Six-Month Period, the “First Twelve-Month Period”), either directly or indirectly, dispose of, enter into any agreement to dispose of or otherwise create any options, rights, interests or encumbrances in respect of any of the Relevant Securities
controller_12m.basis: Rule 10.07(1)(b)-style undertaking: Second Six-Month Period is the six months commencing on expiry of the First Six-Month Period (six months from the Listing Date); frees up on the 12-month anniversary of the Listing Date
controller_12m.notes: Condition (continuation on p.344): restricted 'if, immediately following such disposal ... that person or group of persons would cease to be our controlling shareholder (as defined in the Listing Rules)'. Note 3 pledge-notification undertaking runs to the expiry of the Second Six-Month Period.
